criteria.requirement: Add constraint.cardinality.GlobalCardinality(value_bounds,closed=True) as a real Constraint. Snapshot each value min/max nonnegative strict integer bounds; simultaneously enforce per-value counts, using assigned counts and remaining-domain support as safe necessary pruning conditions. closed=True excludes unlisted values; closed=False allows them. Do not confuse one combined SomeInSet count with independent bounds. Reject repeated variables and invalid bound shapes/ranges; impossible but structurally legal bounds produce no solutions. Forward checking must preserve every brute-force legal assignment across solver modes; unary preprocessing must preserve the earlier declared-domain isolation. Document that this is safe support pruning, not a claim of complete generalized arc consistency.
